title: Concept: MathML container carrying a script
description: A math element with a script nested inside a text container in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: MathML is markup, so a script placed inside it executes with the page's privileges while a sanitiser that only walks HTML elements skips the namespace.
applicability: Deployments that render a math element with a script nested inside a text container into a customer- or partner-facing response.
